sample_greeting: Create a project from a drawing, or open a project.
pdfium_missing: The PDF engine is missing, drawings cannot be opened.
sheet_unit_hint: Unit of the dimensions on this sheet. Dimo never guesses it from the sheet size.
numbering_hint_sheet_zone: Sheet by sheet, zone by zone, then top to bottom and left to right. Without a zone grid the whole sheet is read that way.
numbering_hint_view: View by view in the order the views were drawn, top to bottom and left to right inside a view. Balloons outside all views come last.
numbering_hint_view_clockwise: View by view, clockwise around the view center from 12 o'clock. Balloons outside all views come last.
numbering_hint_kind: Grouped by type, each type in sheet and zone order.
numbering_hint_manual: Keeps the current order. Drag rows in the table to change it.
numbering_locked: Numbering is locked. Existing numbers stay, new characteristics are numbered by the insert policy.
zones_none: No zone grid. Numbering then reads the whole sheet.
zones_columns_letters: A, B, C from the left
zones_columns_letters_reversed: A, B, C from the right
zones_rows_letters: A, B, C from the top
zones_rows_letters_reversed: A, B, C from the bottom
zones_labels_hint: Separate labels with commas. The count of labels sets the number of columns and rows.
regions_drawing_hint: Drag a rectangle on the drawing. Esc cancels.
views_none: No views drawn. Views are used by the per view strategies.
dev_pan_result: {frames} frames, mean {mean} ms, p95 {p95} ms, max {max} ms
unsaved_body: The project has changes that are not saved yet.
notice_restored_unsaved: A project that was not saved yet was restored after the last session ended unexpectedly. Save it to keep it.
notice_recovered: {count} changes were restored from the autosave journal.
notice_dropped: The last change before the unexpected end was incomplete and was dropped.
notice_set_aside: An autosave journal did not match the project and was not applied. It was kept as {path}.
notice_migrated: The project was converted from file format version {version}. Saving writes the current format.
error_in_use: The project is open in another Dimo window.
error_in_use_by: The project is open in another Dimo window (user {user}).
error_newer_version: The project was written by a newer Dimo version (file format {found}, this version reads up to {supported}). Update Dimo to open it.
error_project: The project file could not be read or written: {message}
error_io: A file could not be read: {message}
table_empty: No characteristics yet. Place a balloon on the drawing to add one.
table_locked_manual: Numbering was locked by {user} on {date}. Characteristics cannot be moved while numbering is locked.
table_locked_issued: Numbering was locked when a report was issued ({user}, {date}). Characteristics cannot be moved while numbering is locked.
refusal_numbering_locked: Numbering is locked. Characteristics cannot be moved.
refusal_zero_quantity: The quantity must be at least 1.
refusal_invalid_quantity: The quantity must be a whole number of at least 1.
refusal_invalid_decimal: Not a valid number. Use digits with a point, for example 12.5 or -0.02.
refusal_invalid_move_target: Characteristics cannot be moved before one of themselves.
table_toggle: Table: select row or switch Inspect
dev_table_result: Table: {frames} frames, mean {mean} ms, p95 {p95} ms, max {max} ms
select_all: Select all balloons on the sheet
note_shorter_leg_unknown: Angle: the length of the shorter leg is unknown, so the general tolerance for angles is not applied. Enter the shorter leg below.
shorter_leg_hint: Length of the shorter leg of the angle in the sheet unit. It selects the general tolerance for angles (ISO 2768-1). Leave empty if unknown.
shorter_leg_invalid: Enter a positive number, for example 40 or 12.5.
shorter_leg_stored: Stored leg: {value} {unit}. A new value is in the sheet unit.
shorter_leg_manual_kept: Leg stored. The limits were entered by hand and stay.
shorter_leg_unreadable: Leg stored. The requirement text is not a dimension, so it gives no limits.
note_fit_pair: Fit pair: it names a hole and a shaft. Capture them as two characteristics.
proposal_parse_error: Not read as a callout (character {position}: {expected}). Accepting keeps the text only.
proposal_not_inspected: Reference or basic dimension, not inspected
view_planned: This view comes in a later version.
export_no_project: Create or open a project to export it.
export_language_hint: Language of the column headers in CSV and Excel files and of the reports.
export_open_failed: The file was saved but could not be opened: {message}
export_issued_hint: For drawings and reports that go to a customer. Numbers then stay fixed; new characteristics get the next free number. A report exported as issued is recorded in the project.
export_locked: The numbering is locked. Reports exported as issued are still recorded.
export_pdf_description: A copy of the drawing with the balloons. The original file is not changed.
export_csv_description: For CMM programming and other tools. UTF-8, comma separated.
export_xlsx_description: The same list as an Excel workbook.
export_waiting: Choose where to save the file.
export_blank_columns_hint: Columns of a check sheet when the project has no samples (1 to 10).
export_check_sheet_description: The inspected characteristics with empty result columns, to print and fill in by hand.
export_inspection_report_description: Results, verdicts, summary and signature block of the samples.
export_cancelled: Export cancelled. No file was written.
export_issued_recorded: Recorded as issued; the numbering is locked.
export_issued_project_changed: The project changed during the export, so the report was not recorded as issued. Export it again.
export_issued_refused: The report was not recorded as issued: {message}
export_warning_draft: Some limits come from tolerance tables that are still drafts.
export_warning_open: Results are missing or not evaluated; the overall verdict is open.
export_warning_changed: Limits or result types changed after the last issued report.
language_hint: Changing the language reloads the window.
user_name_hint: Recorded with every change. Leave empty to use the system user name ({name}).
settings_balloon_defaults_hint: Applies to every balloon of the project that has no style of its own.
settings_no_project: Open a project to change its balloon style.
badge_draft_title: Limits from a draft table: its values are not verified yet
badge_no_tolerance_title: No tolerance on the drawing and no rule that gives one: no limits. Check this characteristic.
badge_reference_title: Reference dimension: no limits, not inspected unless you tick Inspect
badge_basic_title: Basic (theoretically exact) dimension: no limits, not inspected unless you tick Inspect
hint_fit_deviations_differ: The printed deviations differ from the fit table for {fit}; the printed ones are used.
hint_unknown_fit: Fit {fit} is not in the fit table.
hint_size_outside_table: The size is outside the ranges of table {table}.
detail_no_rule: No rule recorded yet. Type the requirement text or re-interpret.
detail_reinterpret_hint: Reads the requirement text again with the current tolerance settings, as one undo step. Limits entered by hand stay.
detail_reinterpret_done: Re-interpreted: {count}. Kept because entered by hand: {manual}. Not readable: {unreadable}.
tolerance_settings_hint: Changes apply to characteristics read from now on. To update existing ones, select them and use Re-interpret in the side panel.
tolerance_decimal_rules_hint: For sizes written as decimals without a tolerance, for example 2 places ±0.05.
tolerance_no_custom: No custom tables in this project.
tolerance_imported: Imported {table}. It is saved with the project.
tolerance_import_unchanged: {table} is already in the project. Nothing changed.
tolerance_places_invalid: Decimal places must be a whole number from 0 to 10.
copy_hash_aria: Copy the SHA-256 of the drawing
report_date_today_aria: Set the report date to today
company_name_hint: Printed on reports. Copied into the report details of a project that has no company name yet.
refusal_unknown_revision: This drawing revision no longer exists.
refusal_empty_serial: The serial must not be empty.
refusal_duplicate_serial: Another sample already has this serial.
refusal_too_many_samples: A project holds at most 500 samples.
refusal_invalid_sample_count: Add between 1 and 100 samples at once.
refusal_invalid_date: Not a valid date. Use the form 2026-10-12.
refusal_invalid_result: Not a valid result for this characteristic. Enter a number, or ok or not ok for a go/no go characteristic.
refusal_result_type_conflict: The results of this characteristic do not fit the chosen type. Clear them first.
refusal_invalid_geometry: The position or area is not valid.
refusal_invalid_style: Balloon sizes must be positive numbers.
refusal_invalid_sheet_setting: This sheet setting is not valid (unit, scale, zone grid or view).
refusal_invalid_project_setting: These project settings are not valid.
grid_next_row: Grid: confirm and go to the next characteristic
grid_previous_row: Grid: confirm and go to the previous characteristic
grid_next_sample: Grid: confirm and go to the next sample
grid_previous_sample: Grid: confirm and go to the previous sample
grid_toggle: Grid: switch between OK and not OK
grid_paste: Grid: paste a block of values
measure_refused_number: Not a number. Type digits with a point or comma, for example 12.05 or -0,3.
measure_refused_attribute: Not an OK or not OK result. Type o or + for OK, n or x for not OK.
measure_type_refused: Result type of characteristic {number} not changed: {message}
measure_paste_no_cell: Choose the cell where the pasted block starts.
measure_paste_too_big: The pasted block ({rows} rows by {columns} columns) does not fit from this cell. Add samples or start further up or left.
measure_paste_invalid: a value in the block does not fit the result type of its characteristic.
measure_no_rows: No characteristics to measure. Characteristics with Inspect switched on appear here.
measure_no_samples: No samples yet. Add samples to enter results.
measure_changed_since_issue: Limits or result type changed after the last issued report
measure_no_project: Create or open a project to enter results.
delete_results_body_one: 1 result will be removed with the deleted characteristics. Undo brings it back.
delete_results_body_other: {count} results will be removed with the deleted characteristics. Undo brings them back.
samples_none_active: Choose a sample column to move or delete it.
sample_panel_empty: Choose a sample column in the grid.
